# Descriptions
@@ 1
Gives the caster a 95% chance of predicting the time and severity of any winds
or storms (+/- 15 minutes) over the next 24 hours.
@@ 2
Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10’x10’x3’. This wall reduces all
movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a
-50 penalty.
@@ 3
Target will float upon the air. While floating, the target is at the mercy of
the prevailing winds and cannot control any aspect of his flight without
access to some other motive force (i.e., being towed, etc.).
@@ 4
Caster causes a breeze to come forth that will drive out any gaseous matter
(clouds, etc.) and subtract 10 from all missile attacks. Once set, the
direction of the breeze will not change. Wind speed is between 10-20 miles per
hour.
@@ 5
As Air Wall I, except for duration.
@@ 6
Caster summons a concentrated blast of air to strike one target. Target must
resist or suffer a ''B'' Unbalancing critical.
@@ 7
Caster creates an intense, directed updraft of air that can support a weight
of up to 500 pounds (so long as the weight is concentrated in the area of
effect). The combination of height lifted in feet times weight in pounds is
always equal to 500. For example, a 100-pound man would be lifted 5 feet into
the air; a 500 pound object would be lifted 1 foot into the air; and a 2 pound
object wold be lifted 250 feet into the air. Any unwilling target may make an
RR to remove himself from the area of effect.
@@ 8
As Breeze Call, except for area of effect, range, it subtracts 30 from all
missile attacks, and the wind speed is between 21-31 miles per hour.
@@ 9
Caster can control the speed and direction of normal winds. Caster can
increase or decrease wind speed by 1 mile per hour times his level (e.g., if
the wind speed is normally 20 miles per hour, a 15th level caster could change
the wind speed to any speed between 5 and 35 miles per hour). By directing the
wind against missile attacks, he can cause a -1 modifier for each mph of wind
speed.
@@ 10
As Air Blast I, except it delivers a ''C'' Unbalancing critical.
@@ 11
Target can walk on calm air. This spell only allows for horizontal movement.
Vertical movement must be achieved by other means.
@@ 12
As Air Wall I, except for area of effect and duration.
@@ 13
As Breeze Call, except for area of effect, range, it subtracts 80 from all
missile attacks, and the wind speed is 32-63 miles per hour. This spell may
have various other effects on movement and combat (GM’s discretion).
@@ 14
As Air Blast I, except it delivers a ''D'' Unbalancing critical.
@@ 15
As Wind Mastery I, except caster can vary wind speed by 2 miles per hour per
level.
@@ 16
As Pillar of Wind, except the combination of height lifted in feet times
weight in pounds is equal to 1000.
@@ 17
Caster creates a small, but very powerful windstorm. The storm moves randomly
about at a rate of 10’ per round. All struck by or within the Cyclone, receive
a ''D'' Unbalancing critical and are thrown 5d10 feet away from the Cyclone.
@@ 18
As Windwalking, except target can move at a running pace.
@@ 19
Caster may call forth a wind storm with maximum wind speeds equal to twice his
level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according
to circumstance (and the GM’s discretion).
@@ 20
As Cyclone, except for area of effect and range, it delivers an ''E'' Impact
critical, and it throws targets 10d10 feet away.
@@ 25
As Windrunning, except target can run up to twice normal speed on calm air and
expend exhaustion points as if he were walking.
@@ 30
As Air Blast I, except for range, and it delivers an ''E'' Unbalancing
critical.
@@ 50
Caster summons a chariot made of pure air that is solid enough for the caster
and one other being per ten full levels of experience to ride in. The air
chariot has a movement rate of 50 feet per round per level of the caster.
